notes: The second *if* (t018) is the one written אִם rewritten over the coordinated protasis while the waw takes its own *And* — exactly rule 55's closing ruling on וְאִם־לֹא קָרוֹב → *And if ... or if*; marking it `added` was the competing reading.
*any spot* is a supplied quantifying determiner joining the nominal expression, since no כֹּל or determiner morpheme stands in the phrase (rule 15).
